follow-up time: 12 weeks before pregnancy through 6 weeks postpartum
exposure: Timing of CDI (pre-pregnancy, during pregnancy, postpartum)
cohort: 101 peripartum women with CDI matched with 100 controls without CDI
finding: Peripartum CDI was associated with higher odds of cesarean delivery and lower odds of GBS infection/colonization but did not significantly affect neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Peripartum CDI was associated with higher odds of cesarean delivery, even after controlling for labor arrest disorders.
